versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.1

- Added kilo agent support (reader, doc), expanding supported agents to 19+.
- Updated documentation: SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, README* with full agent lists, new descriptions, and sample commands for all supported agent types.
- Refined display: international/Chinese workbuddy split, clarified A→C→B sync architecture, dashboard coverage, and boundaries per agent.
- Enhanced installation: self-healing minimal package logic and auto-completion guidance.
- Improved CLI: added/updated help, arguments, sync flows, and validation (including 'kilo', workbuddy-ai, and distinctions for international/domestic variants).
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md and revised workflow, bug/edge-case notes, and command guidance for new agent sources and sync directions.

session-sync v0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces cross-agent session sync: read chat history from 15+ AI coding agents (codex, hermes, dsh, zcode, workbuddy, claude, openclaw, cursor, trae, Gemini CLI, and more).
- One-way sync to dsh for continued conversations; also supports Markdown archive export.
- Provides a CLI tool (`sync.py`) with safety checks, interactive and non-interactive confirmations, and comprehensive filtering options.
- Ensures data integrity: dry-run by default, idempotent imports, incrementally sync new turns, and batch confirmation for large imports.
- Includes detailed operational manual and format documentation (see AGENTS.md and docs/FORMATS.md).
- Supports advanced archiving, backup, verification, group attach, prune, and end-to-end self-tests.
